description: Writes a `.provenance.json` sidecar next to a saved artifact (tox, recipe note, recipe bundle, component bundle). Records the sha256 checksum, file size, mtime, source COMP path, originating tdmcp tool, toolchain versions, best-effort git metadata, author, tags, and freeform notes. Offline — no TD bridge required.

artifact_kind.description: What kind of artifact this is — hint only, not validated.

artifact_path.description: Absolute or vault-resolved path to the file to stamp.

author.description: Author label. Defaults to TDMCP_AUTHOR env var then os.userInfo().username.

include_git.description: Capture git commit/branch/dirty from the artifact's directory (best-effort).

notes.description: Short human note to attach to the sidecar.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing sidecar. Set false to refuse if one exists.

comp_path.description: Source COMP path inside TD, e.g. /project1.

tool.description: Originating tdmcp tool name, e.g. make_portable_tox.

name: provenance_stamp
title: Provenance Stamp
